properties.name: 18-AP-1713
properties.notes: Partial demolition of existing post office and flat over, in connection with erection of a part single, part four storey building to include refurbishment of the post office at ground floor level and erection of 3 new floors containing 4 x 1- bedroom flats and 3 x 2 two bedroom flats together with balconies to the front and rear and two communal roof gardens.
